row.evidence: Hootsuite's REST API reference documents a 'SCIM 2.0' User Management API at /scim/v2/Users and /scim/v2/Groups, but no Hootsuite page says which plan includes it; the pricing comparison only marks Single sign-on (SSO) as Enterprise.
row.notes: Status changed from June 'gated' to 'unknown': SCIM clearly exists (public SCIM 2.0 endpoints in the REST API reference, an Entra gallery provisioning app, and an Okta OIN app with SCIM Create/Update/Deactivate/Group Push), but no first-party page names the plan that includes it, so June's Enterprise gate was dropped (Entra's tutorial only says to ask your Hootsuite CSM for the long-lived token). June's '$15k/yr minimum + ~$1,800-2,000/u/mo' Enterprise figures have no first-party source and were dropped; Enterprise is 'Contact for pricing'. Prices unchanged: Standard $99, Professional $199, Advanced $399 per user/mo billed annually (monthly billing also offered). SAML SSO is Enterprise-only per the pricing comparison data and the help centre. The SCIM reference has no DELETE for Users or Groups; deprovisioning is via active=false. Groups map to Hootsuite teams. The non-SCIM REST API can create members, list organization and team members, add members to teams and remove members from an organization.

auth.token_source: Long-lived token requested from your Hootsuite CSM

deprovision.notes: No DELETE operation in the SCIM reference; Entra says it removes users when they no longer need access and maps the 'active' attribute.

custom.how: Entra's change log says the custom extension attributes organizationIds and teamIds were removed for Users.

rate_limits.text: Platform API limit of 20 requests per second and 100,000 calls per day (stated for the REST APIs generally).

limitations.text: The SCIM token is not self-serve: Entra's tutorial says to ask your Hootsuite CSM for a long-lived token.
The SCIM reference has no DELETE endpoint for Users or Groups.

auth.notes: Grant types: authorization_code, refresh_token, member_app and organization_app.

endpoints.purpose: Create member in a Hootsuite organization (requires manage members permission)

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhooks are for Inbox 2.0 CRM integrations only.

rate_limits.text: 20 requests per second, up to 100,000 calls per day.

limitations.text: API use requires an active Hootsuite user and an approved Developer account.

okta.notes: OIN page has SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push, Group Linking, Attribute Sourcing and Attribute Writeback checked (read from page markup); its description also mentions just-in-time provisioning.

google.notes: Hootsuite's SSO guide lists Google as a supported SAML IdP; Google's catalogue page not checked.

onelogin.notes: Hootsuite's SSO guide lists OneLogin as a supported SAML IdP; OneLogin connector pages block bots.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud's article covers SAML SSO configuration only.

fallbacks.notes: Okta's OIN description mentions just-in-time provisioning, but Hootsuite's own SSO guide says to add members to the organization before they use SSO.

open_questions: Which Hootsuite plan includes SCIM provisioning is not stated on any first-party page; the token comes from a CSM, which suggests but does not prove Enterprise.
Whether SSO must be configured before SCIM is not documented.
What deactivation does to the seat and the member's sessions and content is not documented.
Whether the REST API is available on every paid plan is not stated.
